slug: 2025-04-04 Government wants a rigorous control mechanism for issuing the literal (birth) certificate

systems.system: National tour to produce the DIP (Personal Identity Document)
systems.tiers: a national tour of almost a month; 7,670 dossiers obtained and 7,275 processed, reported on 4 April 2025

note: The Vice-President instructed the Ministry of Justice on 4 April 2025 to propose a control mechanism in the civil registries over the issue of the literal birth certificate, after reports of falsified certificates used to obtain the DIP and passport; no registration system is named and nothing is said of how the record is made.
